messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.
By what deadline is the ministerial decree that revises the list of equipment in Annex VII, as envisioned by Article 71(14) of Legislative Decree 81/2008, required to be adopted?

response.text: Entro quale termine deve essere adottato il decreto ministeriale che revisiona l'elenco delle attrezzature di cui all'Allegato VII, previsto dall'articolo 71, comma 14, del decreto legislativo 81/2008?
